text:
Favorite animal: cat

I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help manage comments across your YouTube channels. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, and data cleaning, and I’m comfortable working carefully and consistently with online workflows.

For relevant work, I built a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare by joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That project helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and reduced customer acquisition cost by 12% the next quarter.

I’m proficient in English, reliable, and responsive, and I’m comfortable with quick communication and daily check-ins. I’d be glad to support your channels with timely, thoughtful comment management and help keep engagement organized.
